maps.points.east_garden.a01.title: Go downstairs → Soulforge - Outer Halls
maps.points.east_garden.detail: The air became thick, filled with the smell of decay and damp soil. The once-garden now lay buried in mud and stagnant water.
maps.points.east_garden.detail-10: Before agreeing to assist the fungi in the mushroom fields, offering blood to the frog king will trigger the frog king's fate.
maps.points.east_garden.detail-11: The Frog King falls, his body sinking into the mire as the last trace of golden will fades from the swamp.
maps.points.east_garden.detail-12:
Defeat “Frog King, The final crown in the swamp” (25, 9)
First activation only
maps.points.east_garden.detail-13: You climb the final steps and instead of stone hallways, you step into a dungeon garden.
maps.points.east_garden.detail-14: At (8, -13) Stepped on by the party
maps.points.east_garden.detail-15: A heavy stone gargoyle sits rigidly.
maps.points.east_garden.detail-18: The path unfolds into a pale garden submerged in mist. Twisted trees stand up from the ground like ribs, with bare branches covered in wet dew.
maps.points.east_garden.detail-19: At (17, 7) Stepped on by the party
maps.points.east_garden.detail-2: At (10, 10) Stepped on by the party

Agree to help them.
maps.points.east_garden.detail-21: Step on the sensor at (22, 9) to trigger the "Frog King" event, or defeat any Sporeling.
maps.points.east_garden.detail-3: The three offerings rest in place. Dust swirls toward the center. Upon the pedestal, light gathers out of nothing, weaving itself into a faint, glasslike sphere.
maps.points.east_garden.detail-4: At (3, -4) Trigger, place the required items in the designated positions
maps.points.east_garden.detail-5: Appear in the container or base Blue Key Sphere Location (3, -6)
maps.points.east_garden.detail-6: The forest ground sank into moss and black water. With each step, the earth let out a faint sigh. In front, the faint croaking of frogs echoed through the fog.
maps.points.east_garden.detail-7: At (22, 9) Stepped on by the party
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue: The air turns thick with rot and damp earth. What once was a garden now sinks into mud and still water.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-10: "It touches the mind. Soft and cold." (Requires Slugman)
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-100: Choose “Offer ten coins.” (Have at least 10 gold coins)
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-101: "In the arena, hesitation is death. Move first, strike fast, and deny your foes the chance to gather themselves."
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-102: The path opens into a pale garden drowned in fog. Twisted trees rise like ribs from the soil, their branches bare and slick with dew.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-103: Between them stand strange, mushroom-like figures. Motionless, damp, and glistening green under the mist.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-104: One blocks your way. Another sways among the roots. Ten more linger deeper between the trees, as still as statues.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-105: No breath, no sound. Only the faint hiss of spores drifting through the cold air.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-106: Mushroom power: Sink into the mycelium and listen. (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-108: The clearing is as still as before. Only the faint hiss of spores drifting through the cold air.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-109: Choose “Mushroom power: Sink into the mycelium and listen.”
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-11: Choose “It touches the mind. Soft and cold.”
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-110: You let your thoughts sink downward. Past wet soil and threadlike veins of fungus.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-111: At once, something answers. Not one voice, but many. Thin, trembling, layered together in a single whisper.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-112: Images slide through your mind. Mud. Crowns. Croaking commands. Mushroom Men bowing in stagnant water beneath golden eyes.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-114: The truth settles slowly. These creatures are bound. Pressed beneath the will of the swollen king in the mire.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-115: For a long moment the whisper falters, as if afraid even to form the thought. Then it returns, sharper now.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-116: "We remember before the crown. Before the mire. Before his hunger."
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-119: Ask what they want from you. (once only)
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-12: "Not mind to mind... more like water to flesh. Thoughts sliding through skin."
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-121: Agree to help them. (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-123: A wave of revulsion answers. You see the Frog King as pressure. A will spreading through spores, mud, and still water.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-124: "He calls. We kneel. He hungers. We feed."
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-126: Choose “Ask what they want from you.”
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-127: The whisper tightens, becoming something close to resolve.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-128: "Let him believe you kneel. Let him speak. Let him show the path."
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-129: "When the root splits and the crown leans close, we will answer."
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-13: You feel the same pressure now. Curious, slow, immense.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-130: "Not before. If we rise too soon, he drowns us in silence."
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-132: You send back a single thought: When the time comes, we will listen.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-133: The answer spreads through the mycelium network. Relief. Hatred buried under obedience for far too long.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-135: "Let him fill your mind. Let him taste surrender."
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-136: The presence withdraws. The mushroom field falls quiet.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-138: You push through the mist. The still figures part just enough to let you pass.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-17: "It's not speaking. It's pressing thoughts into minds." you whisper.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-2: Stone paths vanish beneath reeds, arches crumble. It feels as if something broke free from this garden, reshaping the land in its own image.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-21: "It doesn't speak." you whisper. "It *feels*. Every slow heartbeat echoes back from it."
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-22: Select “Let it in.” / “Open your thoughts to it.”
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-23: The world folds inward. Sound dies. Thought becomes water.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-24: Visions surge. Crowned frogs in endless marshes. Cities drowned beneath lily pads. All kneel.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-25: A throne of reeds. Golden eyes watching. Hunger.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-26: The image shifts. A bloodstained fountain of dark water. Blood blooming within it.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-27: The meaning is clear: an offering. A covenant.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-29: Send a thought - ask what the offering brings.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-3: The forest floor sinks into damp moss and black water. Each step draws a quiet gasp from the earth. Ahead, faint croaks echo through the mist.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-31: Choose “Send a thought - ask what the offering brings.”
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-32: At first, nothing. Then the answer seeps in. Slow, heavy, and wet. Crowns sink beneath black water, their wearers ruling still. Mouths of mud whisper orders to the living.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-33: Forests drown, cities rot, yet all still move. Eternal.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-34: The feeling settles over you. Power that outlasts death.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-35: The bloodstained fountain ripples faintly, as if it heard your thought.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-37: Select “Resist the intrusion.” / “Force it away.” / “Try to block the intrusion.”
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-38: You push back. Your skull aches, vision fracturing like glass. The toad's eyes flare brighter. Anger ripples through the air like heat from a forge.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-39: Spores rise from the mud, glowing red. You feel them pulsing with alien intent.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-4: Beyond, the trees part to reveal a swampy glade. At its heart rises a stone throne, half-swallowed by the bog.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-40: A wave of thought slams through the swamp. Command. You see the Mushroom Men turn, heads tilting in unison, roots shifting beneath the mire.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-41: The command echoes inside your skull: a single, dreadful image - your body sinking into the earth. Bones softening into compost for the mire.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-42: Select “Approach the fountain.” / “Approach the mire fountain.”
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-43: You approach the mire fountain. Low stone, half buried in moss. Dark water fills it, streaked with red, green, and gray. The colors of blood and decay.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-44: A foul stench of blood and decay hangs in the air. Bubbles rise.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-45: The toad's gaze presses at your mind, silent but clear: The mire accepts blood.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-46: Cut your hand and let the blood fall into the fountain.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-47: Refuse the call and step away.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-48: Select “Cut open the palm, Let blood fall into the fountain.” / “Spill your blood into the fountain.” (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-49: You kneel by the mire fountain and let the blood fall.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-5: Upon it sits an enormous toad, its skin glistening with rot and dew, its eyes golden.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-50: The black water drinks deeply. The pulse that answers is no longer distant. It is inside you.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-51: The Frog King's gaze widens, golden and bottomless. Thought bends. Then breaks.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-52: You feel the last edge of yourself sink beneath the mire.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-53: There is no pain. No fear. Only obedience.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-54: The crown settles upon your thoughts.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-55: And you kneel forever in the kingdom beneath the mire.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-57: Select “Cut open the palm, Let blood fall into the fountain.” / “Spill your blood into the fountain.”
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-58: You draw the blade across flesh. Blood spills freely, dark and warm, joining the stagnant pool within the fountain.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-59: Your body locks in place. The Frog King's will crashes into you, heavy and absolute.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-6: You feel a pressure deep behind your eyes. Something cold, knocking at the edges of thought.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-60: The mycelium surges. A thousand silent voices rise in defiance, the Mushroom Men snapping upright as one.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-61: Confusion ripples through the king. Then fear. Then rage.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-62: But his will is vast. The Colony falters, held fast beneath it, unable to break free.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-63: Still, that brief fracture is enough. For a single heartbeat his grip loosens. The path opens.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-64: Only you and the King of the Mire.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-66: You wrench the images away. The king convulses in fury. Visions explode behind your eyes. Boiling marsh, shattered moons, faces dissolving into mud.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-67: The toad's eyes blaze gold, its rage pouring straight into your thoughts: Kneel or drown.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-68: Stand your ground and defy the vision.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-70: You approach the bloodstained fountain. Low stone, half buried in moss. Dark water fills it, streaked with red, green, and gray. The colors of blood and decay.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-71: The air smells of iron and rot. Bubbles rise, slow and deliberate.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-73: Select “Reject the vision.” / “Refuse the call., Turn around and leave.”
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-74: You wrench the visions away as the swamp convulses in fury: boiling marshes, shattered moons, faces sinking into mud, while the toad's golden gaze burns into your mind: Kneel or drown.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-75: Spill your blood into the fountain.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-76: Select “Stand your ground., Resist illusions.” / “Refuse the call.”
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-77: You push the visions away one last time. The toad's eyes blaze gold. A single pulse runs through the mire.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-78: Mushroom Men turn as one, their heads snap toward you, eyes clouded white, limbs moving in perfect rhythm.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-79: You see it in your mind's eye, your body sinking, flesh softening into soil.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-80: The thought follows, cold and certain: Compost for the mire.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-82: The Frog King falls, his body sinking into the mire as the last trace of golden will fades from the swamp.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-83: Subsequent dialogue (Task "Roots of Rebellion" has not failed yet)
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-84: The Frog King collapses into the mire, his vast form sinking into the water as the golden light gutters and dies.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-85: Then the Mushroom Men rise, one by one, no longer bowed. Their thoughts brush yours. Quiet, steady, and finally free.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-86: And in the garden, stillness returns.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-87: For a moment, there is silence. Still... you are not of this place and the swamp remembers.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-88: You climb the final steps and instead of stone hallways, you step into a dungeon garden.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-89: Trees and shrubs stand where they were placed. Beyond the arches, mountains rise vast and distant.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-90: The plaque on the pedestal mentions the puzzle of the three offerings.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-91: Etched into the stone slab below: "Ten coins for guidance".
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-93: Choose “Offer ten coins” (Fewer than 10 gold coins)
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-94: Choose “Offer ten coins” (Have at least 10 gold coins)
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-95: You drop the coins into the gargoyle's open mouth.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-96: "Three offerings. One is meant for hunger, one for little wounds, and one is touched by the moon."
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-97: The plaque on the base refers to the Test of Courage trial ahead.
maps.points.east_garden.dialogue-99: Choose “Offer ten coins.” (Fewer than 10 gold coins)

Born in flames, Shaped by hands,
To feed the hungry people on earth.

A small glass bottle containing healing red liquid,
Those who fear the dead search everywhere.

Born under the quiet sky,
Never to drink the sunlight, It will never die.
